fire:
Any line in the plane can be written in the form
 ax + by = c

The kinetic energy is then expressed as
 K = p^2 / 2m

The general formula for simple interest is:
 I = P r t

In polar coordinates the curve takes the form
 r = 2 cos(t)

Solving for x, the quadratic can be rewritten as
 x = (-b + sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / 2a

The density of the gas is given by
 rho = P M / (R T)

Using the chain rule, the derivative becomes
 f'(g(x)) g'(x)

The volume of a sphere is:
 V = 4/3 pi r^3
